introduction: DC unemployment insurance provides temporary support for qualifying workers. DOES lists initial claims, weekly certifications and account services separately.
description: DC unemployment insurance provides temporary support for qualifying workers. DOES lists initial claims, weekly certifications and account services separately.

sections.who: DOES assesses wages, job separation and ongoing eligibility. Follow the current claimant handbook for work-search, availability and earnings-reporting duties.
sections.get: Payments depend on an approved claim and continued eligibility. Review the determination for the amount and payment arrangements.
sections.docs:
• Employer, employment-date and wage history.
  • Information about separation or reduced hours.
  • Identity and account records requested during filing.
sections.apply:
1. Start through DOES

    Follow the DCNetworks claim link on DOES Start Your Unemployment Process.

  2. Certify weekly

    Use the listed weekly-claim instructions, answering the questions for each claimed week.

  3. Check account tasks

    Review requests, payment history and notices. Claim help is listed at 202-724-7000 or 877-319-7346.
sections.after: Keep confirmations and the determination. If wages or eligibility appear incorrect, use the review or appeal instructions promptly.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DOES claim and account services. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
